name: WishBone Medical, Inc.

about:
WishBone Medical, Inc. is a pediatric orthopedic company based in Warsaw, Indiana. The company focuses on the unmet needs of children suffering from orthopedic issues, aiming to provide anatomically appropriate solutions for growing patients.

The company designs and manufactures anatomically appropriate implants and instruments, delivered in single-use, sterile-packed procedure kits. Its product lines include growth control systems, plating systems, and bone void fillers. Kits are assembled with multi-barrier sterile packaging and include web-based software for precise correction in all planes. All instruments are supplied sharp and pristine for each procedure, eliminating the need for loaner trays and reducing operating room turnover time.

WishBone Medical serves pediatric orthopedic surgeons and hospitals, providing kits that streamline procedural efficiency and reduce overall patient care costs. Its customers include medical facilities that perform pediatric orthopedic surgeries.

The company was founded to address the lack of anatomically appropriate solutions for growing patients. Its single-use kit model aims to reduce infection risk, eliminate set processing, and decrease hospital setup and processing time, enabling more children to receive proper treatment each day.
